world_read.summary: A textured lavender-blue painted field holds a dense iris clump on the left and a smaller, lighter clump on the right. Violet and yellow blossoms punctuate overlapping green leaves. One conspicuous forest-green blade arches from the left clump across the upper middle, ending in a fine downward hook. This planned anchor is visible, but the many surrounding leaves and all-over brushwork make the composition busier than a minimal expressionist plate.
mood: Landscape painting of two unequal iris foliage islands across a broad blue-lilac interval. A dominant hooked forest-green blade arches partway across the gap; smaller spears and crossing leaves stop short. Sparse crumpled yellow-ochre and violet-pink blossoms droop on thin stems. Broken cream and lavender curls weave around both clusters, pale loops threading the lower-right leaves. Bristle-drag paint, diffuse light.
